# ProClear Solutions AZ — Comprehensive Overview

> ProClear Solutions is a locally-owned Arizona property preservation company specializing in foreclosure cleanouts, trash-outs, and property turnover services. We serve REO companies, asset managers, landlords, and government agencies statewide with 24-48 hour response times. Bonded, insured, and GSE compliant. Based in Tucson, AZ.

## About ProClear Solutions

ProClear Solutions was founded to provide fast, reliable, and professional property preservation services across Arizona. We specialize in the cleanup and preparation of foreclosed, vacant, and distressed properties — turning them from abandoned liabilities into market-ready assets.

We work primarily with REO servicers, asset management companies, banks, property managers, and government agencies who need properties cleaned out, secured, and maintained to GSE (Government-Sponsored Enterprise) standards. Every job is photo-documented, completed within 24-48 hours, and performed with eco-friendly disposal practices.

Based in Tucson with statewide coverage, we understand Arizona's unique property challenges — from monsoon damage and desert landscaping to the specific requirements of the Arizona real estate market.

## Detailed Service Descriptions

### Foreclosure Cleanouts
Complete interior and exterior cleanout of foreclosed properties:
- Removal of all personal property, debris, and trash left by previous occupants
- Appliance removal and disposal
- Furniture and household goods removal
- Garage, shed, and outbuilding cleanout
- Properties left broom-clean and ready for listing
- Compliant with Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, and HUD requirements
- Photo documentation before, during, and after work
- Typical turnaround: 24-48 hours

### Trash-Out Services
Professional junk removal with responsible disposal:
- Full property trash-outs of any size
- Construction debris removal
- Yard waste and bulk item hauling
- Donation of salvageable items to local charities
- Recycling of applicable materials
- Eco-friendly disposal practices
- Dumpster coordination for large jobs

### Yard & Landscape Maintenance
Property exterior maintenance and curb appeal restoration:
- Lawn mowing and edging
- Weed abatement and control
- Tree and shrub trimming
- Desert landscaping cleanup (common in Arizona properties)
- Gravel and rock maintenance
- Initial clean-up and ongoing maintenance packages
- HOA compliance preparation

### Lock Changes & Property Securing
Full property securing services:
- Deadbolt installation on all exterior doors
- Lock re-keying
- Padlock installation for gates, sheds, and outbuildings
- Window securing
- Board-up services for broken windows/doors
- Lockbox installation for agent access
- Code compliance for secured vacant properties

### Handyman & Minor Repairs
General maintenance and repair services:
- Minor plumbing repairs (leaking faucets, running toilets, pipe fixes)
- Minor electrical work (outlet/switch replacement, light fixtures)
- Drywall patching and repair
- Fixture replacement (towel bars, door handles, cabinet hardware)
- Door and window repairs
- General property maintenance tasks
- Make-ready repairs for rental turnovers

### Property Inspections
Professional condition assessments:
- Comprehensive photo-documented interior/exterior inspections
- Occupancy verification checks
- Property condition reports for asset managers and lenders
- Damage assessment documentation
- Code violation identification
- Regular scheduled inspection programs
- Reports delivered digitally within 24 hours

### Paint & Touch-Ups
Cosmetic restoration and painting:
- Full interior painting (walls, ceilings, trim)
- Exterior painting and touch-ups
- Cabinet refinishing
- Stain and odor-sealing primer application
- Color matching for touch-up work
- Turnover-ready cosmetic preparation
- Curb appeal restoration

### Winterization & De-Winterization
Plumbing system protection for vacant properties:
- Compressed air blow-out of water lines
- Antifreeze treatment for all drains, toilets, and traps
- Water heater draining
- Sprinkler/irrigation system winterization
- Spring de-winterization and system restart
- Water system testing and verification
- Documentation for asset manager records

## Compliance & Standards

- **GSE Compliant** — All work meets Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, and HUD property preservation standards
- **Photo Documentation** — Before, during, and after photos on every job for audit trails
- **Bonded** — Bonded for property and client protection
- **Fully Insured** — Comprehensive general liability insurance
- **Eco-Friendly** — Responsible disposal practices with donation and recycling of salvageable materials
- **5-Star Rated** — Consistently high client satisfaction ratings

## Ideal Clients

- **REO servicers** who need reliable, compliant property preservation vendors in Arizona
- **Asset management companies** managing portfolios of distressed properties
- **Banks and financial institutions** with foreclosed property inventory
- **Property management firms** handling tenant turnovers and vacancy maintenance
- **Landlords and private investors** who need fast, reliable property turnovers
- **Government agencies** (HUD, VA, municipal) with property preservation requirements
- **Real estate agents** handling distressed property listings that need cleanup before showing
